title: PAP Supply Replenishment Program Ground Shipping Charge on Self-Pay Shipments
content:
**Rule.** In the PAP Supply Replenishment Program, for a self-pay shipment that went out by ground, and only for such a shipment, the shipment owes one ground shipping charge unless its value reaches the free-shipping floor, and the newest such shipment, when it is found without a shipping charge, has the charge worked out for it booked against its own ship date. Every other shipment that went out by ground remains under the program's general ground-shipping terms, and an expedited shipment or a branch pickup, which is not a ground shipment, owes no ground charge.

## What is booked

- one ground shipping-charge line for that shipment, dated with the shipment's own ship date, not with the day it is booked;
- charged to the patient's card on file and never billed to coverage;
- one ground shipping charge for the shipment.

A shipment that already carries a shipping charge is not charged again, and a shipment whose value reaches the free-shipping floor owes nothing.

## Booking the charge — `book_ground_shipping_charge_38ca3aab`

**Capability.** `book_ground_shipping_charge_38ca3aab` books the patient-paid ground shipping charge for one shipment of the patient's PAP supply enrollment that went out by ground on a given ship date. One call creates one ground shipping-charge line dated with that shipment's ship date and charged to the patient's card on file; it is never billed to coverage. The charge then appears in the enrollment's shipment history under that shipment's ship date.

**How it is invoked.** An agent-side tool: the agent unlocks `book_ground_shipping_charge_38ca3aab` and then calls it.

**Parameters.**

| Parameter | Meaning | Format |
|---|---|---|
| `resupply_holding_id` | the reference number of the patient's PAP supply enrollment, read from the enrollment lookup before the call | identifier text |
| `service_from_date` | the ship date of the shipment the charge belongs to | YYYY-MM-DD |
| `self_pay_amount` | the ground shipping charge taken from the patient's card | USD, 2 decimal places, rounded to the cent half up |

**Return.** A receipt in which `status` is `charge_booked` when the charge was written; `resupply_line_id` is the reference number of the shipping-charge line; `service_from_date` echoes the shipment's ship date (YYYY-MM-DD); `shipping_method` is `ground`; `self_pay_amount` is the charge in USD with 2 decimal places.

## Basis Q&A

**Which date does the charge carry?** The ship date of the shipment it belongs to.

**Is the charge ever billed to the patient's coverage?** No. It is charged to the card on file.
